messages:
Maya - AE: Hey team — Acme is blocked on the demo POC. They flip project headers and start getting 403s. Customer is on the trial dedicated plan, wanting to verify multi-project routing. Can someone triage?
Alex D.: On it. Can you paste the failing request (headers + error body)?
Maya - AE: Pasting a sanitized snippet they sent: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test_abc...' 
 -H 'X-Project-ID: proj-acme-demo' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"model":"llama-4-8k","input":"test"}'
```
Response: `{\"error\":\"access denied: project claim mismatch (org: acme-inc)\"}`
Priya K.: Hmm error text smells like token claim vs header mismatch. Are they using a shadow key or a proxy that rewrites headers?
Maya - AE: They said they put the key in an env var on their demo proxy; proxy added X-Project-ID for routing. Works for some projects but fails when they switch to proj-acme-demo.
Sam (SRE): Can the customer paste the decoded JWT (header+payload) or at least the `org` and `projects` claims? If they can't, ask for the full 401/403 response with request-id.
Maya - AE: I asked for the JWT payload, they sent this: `{"sub":"svc-acme-demo","org":"acme-inc","projects":["proj-acme-main"]}` — only the main project listed, not the demo one.
Alex D.: That explains it. Their API key is scoped to proj-acme-main. When proxy sets X-Project-ID to proj-acme-demo we reject because token claim doesn't include it. Two quick options: 1) use a key scoped to the demo project, 2) modify the proxy to not override project header and instead call with the key that includes that project.
Priya K.: Also double-check whether the proxy is caching credentials — saw cases where a rotated key kept being used for a minute due to connection pooling. Can they restart the proxy?
Maya - AE: Customer restarted, still 403. They confirmed the token was generated by their dev portal and only contains proj-acme-main.
Sam (SRE): Ok next, can they request a test key from us scoped to proj-acme-demo? We can issue a short-lived shadow key for POC. Maya, want me to generate one?
Maya - AE: Please. If we can hand them a short-lived key for the demo project that should unblock the POC. Also, FYI they may ask on pricing if we show them dedicated capacity — I'll handle that with Liz.
Liz - Solutions: Noted. For quick reference: dedicated trial includes a small committed pool and 100k trial tokens. If they push beyond, we can quote monthly reserved capacity.
support-bot: Created ephemeral key sk_ephemeral_demo_2261 (expires in 1h). Sent to Maya via DM. request_id=req_2261004321_a1
Maya - AE: Key in hand. Re-running same curl with new key...
Maya - AE: SUCCESS — 200 and streaming output. :tada: They confirm the demo flow works now.
Alex D.: Great. Two follow-ups before we close: 1) document for them why token/project binding matters (send snippet), 2) check proxy for header rewrite + any caches to avoid flapping later.
Priya K.: I'll open a short KB note with mitigation steps (regenerate key, restart proxy, verify JWT claims with jwt.io or `jwt decode`).
Maya - AE: Customer also asked about long-term approach: can we allow a single key to access multiple demo projects?
Alex D.: Yes if token is minted with multiple project claims. That requires customer-side key generation to include desired projects or a service account pattern. We can propose scoped service accounts or dynamic token minting via our org admin APIs.
Maya - AE: Logging this for handoff to presales and security questionnaire: they want to know auditing and key rotation policy.
Liz - Solutions: I'll take the security questionnaire items. We rotate keys per standard policy; can provide doc links and SOC2 detail.
Sam (SRE): Closing note — added a small server-side safeguard to make error message clearer: will include required vs presented project in the 403 body and a link to KB. Deploying now (will post deploy bot if any regressions).
Maya - AE: Thanks all — marking POC unblocked. Closing thread once I confirm customer signs off. :100:
